newsitem.title: USA: Atlanta airport sees 10 pct passenger gain in 1996.
newsitem.headline: Atlanta airport sees 10 pct passenger gain in 1996.

text.p: Passenger traffic at Atlanta's Hartsfield International Airport jumped nearly 10 percent in 1996, to 63.3 million passengers, airport officials said.
The airport's passenger count has climbed by 67 percent since 1991, the year Eastern Airlines folded and traffic fell to 38 million passengers.
The 1996 increase came despite the 15-week shutdown of ValuJet Inc and a drop in average daily traffic during the Summer Olympics, offsetting Games-related gains during the rest of the year.
International traffic pushed past the 3 million mark, up 5 percent over 1995.
Delta Air Lines Inc, remained the airport's largest carrier, handling 76 percent of Hartsfield's traffic in 1996.
